'''Ljungskile SK''' is a Swedish professional [[Football (soccer)|football club]] located in [[Ljungskile]], a town within [[Uddevalla Municipality]]. They currently play in [[Superettan]], the second tier of Swedish football, after promotion from [[Ettan Fotboll|Ettan]] in 2025."}}
